our_title: Distributed mapping output dereferences a NULL fragment part array for a mapping with no computed parttab
ran: mpirun -np 3 build/bin/dgpart 9 bump.grf /dev/null -Cd -m'r{sep=q{strat=f}}' (after the CLI-01 fix lets -m reach the mapper): 'dmapping_io.c:256:34: runtime error: load of null pointer of type Anum' then SIGSEGV across ranks. Pristine masks it by discarding -m (CLI-01).
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/dmapping_io.c:256 (dmapSave); fed by SCOTCH_dgraphMapCompute which, unlike the sequential graphMapCompute2, does not pre-allocate the mapping part array
evidence: dmapping_io.c:256 `termloctab[fraglocnum] = archDomNum (&dmapptr->archdat, &fragptr->domntab[fragptr->parttab[fraglocnum]]);` with fragptr->parttab == NULL for a strategy fragment that produced no local mapping.

fix_options.label: Pre-initialise / validate the distributed mapping like graphMapCompute2
fix_options.summary: Either allocate+initialise the kdgraph mapping before running the strategy (the fix this group applied to the sequential graphMapCompute2) or reject a distributed strategy that leaves a fragment unset in dmapSave.
fix_options.tested: untested: the fix belongs in library_dgraph_map.c / kdgraph (not a G05 file) and needs the distributed-mapping owner to choose pre-allocate vs reject.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Pre-allocation mirrors the sequential fix; rejection changes the error contract.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Parallel of the PS2-G12-2 fix, but in the distributed path owned by the dgraph groups.

our_title: Mapping strategy with no initial-mapping method dereferences a NULL part array
ran: repro/PS2-G12-2/map.c 32-bit ASan: `./map 'f{bal=0.05}'` -> 'kgraph_cost.c:104:13: load of null pointer of type Anum' (m.parttax NULL); `b{width=3,bnd=f,org=f}' same; `d{pass=10}' SEGV. Patched (mapAlloc+kgraphFrst in graphMapCompute2): all ret=0 maxpart=0; default strategy and check_scotch_graph_map/map_copy unchanged.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/library_graph_map.c:272-294 (graphMapCompute2: kgraphInit then kgraphMapSt, no mapAlloc); kgraph.c mapInit leaves m.parttax NULL; consumers kgraph_cost.c:104, kgraph_map_fm/df/bd
evidence: graphMapCompute2 ran kgraphMapSt on a Kgraph whose m.parttax was only declared by kgraphInit; only the ml/rb/band methods call mapAlloc, so a refinement-first strategy dereferenced NULL.

fix_options.label: Allocate+initialise the mapping in graphMapCompute2
fix_options.summary: mapAlloc(&mapgrafdat.m)+kgraphFrst after kgraphInit, as kgraphMapMlUncoarsen does, so every method starts from the trivial single-domain mapping.
fix_options.tradeoffs: One extra allocation (freed by kgraphExit); refinement-first strategies now return the trivial mapping instead of crashing.

fix_options.label: Reject strategies whose first method needs a mapping
fix_options.summary: errorPrint+return in kgraphMapSt when m.parttax==NULL for a refinement method.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Needs a per-method flag; returns an error where a trivial mapping is usable.

our_title: graphMapCompute2 copies back the mapping even after the strategy failed
ran: Covered by the same repro: once the part array is always allocated (PS2-G12-2 fix), mapTerm no longer reads a NULL array; the added `if (o == 0)` guard also stops a failed mapping from being written to the user array. Verified no regression in check_scotch_graph_map.
read_only: The specific failed-mapping path G13 exercised via its GRA-17 resize injection was not re-run here; the guard is a pure error-path change.
evidence: Pristine: `o = kgraphMapSt (&mapgrafdat, mapstraptr); mapTerm (&mapgrafdat.m, lmapptr->parttab - baseval);` -- mapTerm runs regardless of o.

fix_options.label: Propagate the result only on success
fix_options.summary: Guard mapTerm with `if (o == 0)` so a failed mapping is not exposed.
fix_options.tested: built and run with the PS2-G12-2 repro; no regression.
fix_options.tradeoffs: On failure the user array keeps its prior contents and o!=0 is returned, as today on success.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Consistent with returning o from graphMapCompute2 and his 'do not touch outputs on error' style; folded into the same commit as PS2-G12-2 (both in graphMapCompute2).
